dedupe_keys.name: attest optimisation tool for transmission network planning wp3 t3 2

description: This is the optimisation tool for transmission network planning developed in work package 3 of the EU-funded ATTEST project. It was published on Zenodo in October 2023 by Kong Wangwei, Andrey Churkin, José Nicolás Melchor Gutiérrez and Eduardo Alejandro Martínez Ceseña. The tool uses a three-stage, scenario-based stochastic optimisation to minimise network reinforcement and operating costs, decomposing the problem into investment and operation models, with a screening model that pre-selects candidate investments. Flexibility offered by distribution networks at the transmission-distribution interfaces is included, a stochastic operation model finds worst-case short-term conditions, and security-constrained AC optimal power flow checks N-1 security. Inputs are network cases with future scenarios, Excel time series of demand, generation and flexibility, contingency lists and intervention costs; examples use a Portuguese 2030 transmission network. It runs from a Python command-line interface. Coverage is not tied to a place. The code is downloadable from Zenodo under the EUPL 1.2 at no cost. Caveats: it is a project release without ongoing maintenance, and defaults are used when inputs are missing. Simulation uses are transmission reinforcement planning under uncertainty with flexibility and N-1 security. Related records: data-attest-networks gives the ATTEST test networks.
inputs: network data with future scenarios and generation costs (MATPOWER-style .m)
demand, generation and flexibility time series (Excel)
